notes.title: Ship Simulator: Maritime Search and Rescue - Update 1.03.00
notes.notes:
New update to Ship Simulator: Maritime Search and Rescue has been released.

The update will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted.

Patch Notes for Version 1.03.00:

Features
	- Additional Settings for Free Driving in Sassnitz and Helgoland. They get unlocked during the story.
	- Added Mouse Sensitivity for First Person Mode in options
	- Added Music On Off in options
	- Added MouseInvert in First Person Mode in options
	- Added Horn, just press Space or Return in game, have fun.
	
Bugfix
	- Fixed the dialog that didn't start on some users when starting the escort part in Swenja.
	- First Person Mode doesn't stop at walls anymore. Instead it slides at the wall.
	- First Person Mode walking and stairs climbing is now faster.
	- Fixed the missing radio dialog that explains the water cannons.
	- Disabled EngineController to eliminate any possibilty to control the ships in the main menu.
	- Particles on daughterboat were disabled after entering and releasing the daughterboat from the mothership
	- Seat cameras in Marwede now higher positioned.
	- Water in daughterboat improved
	- Game Start Button in Mission Selection now only clickable when mission is choosen.
